comment: Golden vectors for the quantity display SSOT (barcode-design-v2-review.md §5.3/§6, Final Decision 12). Consumed by BOTH the web test (scripts/run_golden_quantity_vectors.js) and the Flutter test (test/quantity_golden_test.dart). Each case: input sale line → expected display intent {unit, count}. count may be fractional for the documented legacy fallback only.
